Migrate This

Migrate This

Moves a user's files, settings and app list from an old Windows 11 Pro PC to a new one over the network, or through a thumb drive, share or OneDrive. Graphical app plus a console script, one shared engine.

v2.3.0PowerShell 5.1 + WPFNothing to installRuns from a thumb drive or share

Put it on a thumb drive or share

MigrateThis\ ├─ Migrate This.cmd double-click: graphical app ├─ Migrate This (Console).cmd console in an admin window ├─ MigrateThis-Console.ps1 scriptable, no GUI ├─ README.md └─ App\ ├─ MigrateThis.ps1 graphical front end ├─ MigrateThis.Core.ps1 shared engine └─ Assets\ background, icon
  1. Have the user sign in to the new PC once.
  2. On the new PC, double-click Migrate This.cmd and approve the admin prompt.
  3. Connect to the old PC, pick the profile, review what the search found, start.
  4. The user signs in: drives, printers, wallpaper and RDP history apply then.

Console version

Run from an elevated PowerShell. Leave any parameter out and it asks.

Interactive
.\MigrateThis-Console.ps1
Unattended direct pull
.\MigrateThis-Console.ps1 -Mode Direct -Computer LAPTOP-0421 -SourceUser jsmith -Yes
Direct push from the old PC (user keeps working)
.\MigrateThis-Console.ps1 -Mode Push -Computer NEW-LAPTOP-07 -SourceUser jsmith -Yes
Sizes and time estimate only
.\MigrateThis-Console.ps1 -Mode Direct -Computer LAPTOP-0421 -SourceUser jsmith -ListOnly
Item IDs for -Include / -Exclude
.\MigrateThis-Console.ps1 -ListItems

Build an .exe

On any Windows PC with internet access, from the unzipped folder:

Install-Module ps2exe -Scope CurrentUser
Invoke-ps2exe .\App\MigrateThis.ps1 .\MigrateThis.exe -noConsole -requireAdmin -STA -title "Migrate This" -iconFile .\App\Assets\icon.ico

Keep the App folder next to the .exe, because the engine and background load from it. Antivirus tools sometimes flag ps2exe output, so sign it or allow-list it.
